description: Nolan Family Law & Mediation Services in Sydney help you navigate the separation process with plain language and a focus on positive outcomes.
html:
Our Expert Team Help You Navigate Family Law With Empathy & Experience

At Nolan Family Law & Mediation our aim is to help you navigate the family law process with plain language, realistic expectations, empathy and a focus on positive outcomes. We genuinely care about you and your unique situation.

We understand that your circumstances are different, meaning that your journey is going to be individual to you. We empathise with how you are feeling, and we know how emotional the journey of family law can be.

Our team of expert family lawyers pride themselves on being accessible, empathetic, professional and genuine. We strive to find amicable and equitable outcomes for you and your dependents, while remaining highly capable in confidently championing your rights.

Sydney's Awarded Family Lawyers

Why Nolan Is Different To Other Family Lawyers

Focus On The Best Outcome

We focus on securing the best outcome possible for both parties through professional legal representation and will always try to avoid going to court.

Frequent & Consistent Communication

We’re always available to answer any questions and we provide frequent, consistent communication on your case’s progress.

Pragmatic Advice & Straight Answers

Our team offers pragmatic advice and straightforward answers, so you know exactly where you stand and what your options are.

A Customised Strategy

Since no two divorce cases are the same, you’ll get a detailed, customised plan based on your specific situation, so that you know what to expect throughout the process.

Compassion

You will have focused attention from a compassionate team that genuinely cares about you and your wellbeing.

Professionally Recognised Representation

Our lawyers are consistently recognised by their peers in the Doyle’s Guide as leading family lawyers in Sydney.

Meet Our Experienced Family Law Team

Our team of experienced family lawyers understand that the only winners in long, drawn out court battles are lawyers.

Instead, we strive on your behalf to find mutually acceptable agreements with both parties before matters proceed to court. This can help you achieve a reasonable outcome in a professional and effective manner.

The idea of a “bulldog lawyer fighting for you” is outdated.

An aggressive, combative approach can result in a lengthy expensive processes that is damaging for all parties involved and costs you more than is needed.

Instead we focus on being open and communicative to create an amicable and equitable outcome for you and your dependants – while remaining highly capable in confidently championing your rights.

We’re proud to be consistently recognised in the Doyle’s Guide as a Leading Recommended family law firm in Sydney. While this acknowledgement from our peers matters, what matters most to us is the trust of the people we support; individuals and families navigating some of the most difficult moments of their lives.
